title: Tls.CryptoStream has been removed
summary: Node.js removed tls.CryptoStream (DEP0042: documentation-only since v0.11.3, end-of-life since v10.0.0).

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the usage
steps.instructions: Replace each reported use of tls.CryptoStream with tls.TLSSocket.
